description: This file defines a Dagger module (`DispatchersModule`) that provides coroutine dispatchers (`IO` and `Default`) to the dependency injection framework, setup with Hilt. It registers provider functions for these dispatchers, which are annotated with custom `@Dispatcher` qualifiers.

classes.name: DispatchersModule
classes.description: A Dagger module that provides coroutine dispatchers for dependency injection, specifically IO and Default dispatchers.

methods.name: providesIODispatcher
methods.description: Provides the IO dispatcher for injection, annotated with a custom @Dispatcher(IO) qualifier.

methods.name: providesDefaultDispatcher
methods.description: Provides the Default dispatcher for injection, annotated with a custom @Dispatcher(Default) qualifier.
